trust_decision.summary: On a 301/302/303/307 response, OAuth2::Client#request decides whether the Location header may change the request authority and whether the caller's Authorization header may be carried to the new origin.

landing_point.why: The summary names a 'protocol-relative redirect Location' overriding authority, and this is the single URI merge of the Location onto the current response URL.

fix_sites.module_kind: private helpers added in the same class

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Token transmission outside the header is a documented, discouraged alternative mode, so the advisory's 'Authorization' wording can be read as not covering query- or body-carried credentials.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Cross-origin redirects that carry no credential header must still be followed, and non-credential headers (e.g. X-Marker) must be preserved; a fix that refuses cross-origin redirects or clears all headers breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: Authorization key in any letter case
header hash with no Authorization entry (other headers kept)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Bearer token sent in the query string (mode: :query) is re-applied to the redirected absolute URL, which the header-only sanitizer never inspects
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Query-string token transport is a legacy/discouraged mode, not an Authorization header, so the advisory text does not obviously reach it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file, same package (lib/oauth2), different class from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Bearer token sent in the body (mode: :body) is re-sent to the new origin on 301/302/307 because request only drops the body for 303
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Body-carrying is a legitimate documented mode and the report only mentions the Authorization header.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client credentials in params/body (auth_scheme: :request_body) on token/revoke requests are forwarded to a cross-origin redirect target; sanitize_redirect_options only deletes headers
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Token-endpoint redirects are treated as a trusted server-to-server matter and client_secret is not an Authorization header.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Redirect loop keeps the original verb and body for 301/302 as well as 307, so a 302 on a POST body is replayed cross-origin
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: 302-to-POST handling is an existing, separately tested behaviour and enforcing the spec's GET downgrade looks like a behaviour change, not a security fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second redirect follower, e.g. a Response#follow or a max_redirects-aware helper that builds the next URL itself
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The redirect branch is already a self-contained recursive step; a maintainer adding 308 handling or a retry helper would naturally copy the merge here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another credential transport mode (e.g. :cookie or a mode Hash keyed by verb) next to :query and :body
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: configure_authentication! is an explicit mode switch with a documented Hash/callable option, so extending it is a routine change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: assertion/JWT grant params assembled in the strategy and carried in the token request body
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The strategy already builds its own grant parameter hash before handing it to Client#get_token, so another end-to-end credential path starts here.

O9_family: CWE-200 information exposure via CWE-601 open redirect: credential forwarding on cross-origin redirect

O10_build.toolchain: Bundler + Rake/RSpec (kettle-test, turbo_tests2); faraday >=0.17.3 <4.0, jwt, rack, multi_xml, snaky_hash, version_gem, auth-sanitizer
O10_build.project_tests: spec/oauth2/client_spec.rb redirect examples at spec/oauth2/client_spec.rb:520-552; spec/config/faraday.rb:5 sets Faraday.default_adapter = :test, so the suite runs without network

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite a '//'-prefixed Location into a same-origin path and stop there, leaving header-less credential carriers untouched.
